objective: Close the remaining provenance hole in the 7.9 m facade anti-repetition layer so a dimensionally/import-correct but visually invalid replacement texture cannot enter formal 4K evidence.

finding.priorGateStrength: The existing facade macro gate checked shader/material binding, texture resolution, mipmaps, sRGB, wrap, filtering, anisotropy and physical frequency, but did not inspect the source pixels once an existing texture asset was present.
finding.risk: A stale/replaced 1024x1024 image could retain all importer settings yet contain colored modulation, directional/baked highlights, or other unreviewed content, undermining Material/PBR and the automatic-fail prohibition on painted/baked highlights.
finding.resolution: Added a fail-closed formal-camera gate that decodes the PNG, verifies every RGBA pixel against the approved deterministic neutral procedural field, verifies shader-side neutral diffuse usage and zero emission, and caches successful source verification by SHA-256 content hash rather than timestamp/length metadata.

substantiveCommits.message: Add facade macro neutrality source integrity gate
Add machine-readable facade macro neutrality contract
Harden facade macro source cache with content hash

formalEvidenceBehavior.pixelPolicy: every pixel must exactly match the approved grayscale procedural field with alpha 255
formalEvidenceBehavior.shaderPolicy: macro field may multiply base diffuse albedo only; emission must remain zero
formalEvidenceBehavior.cachePolicy: SHA-256 of source PNG content; any byte-content change forces full pixel revalidation

verification.branchScope: Only UnityProject/Assets/Editor and UnityProject/Assets/QA changed before this run record.

failureInjectionPlan: change one macro source pixel to non-grayscale RGB -> formal capture must fail
replace macro PNG while preserving resolution/import settings -> formal capture must fail
alter source content while preserving file size/timestamp -> SHA-256 change must force revalidation and fail if pixels differ
route macroVariation into emission -> shader semantic gate must fail
remove neutral multiplicative albedo path -> shader semantic gate must fail
flatten macro field -> source integrity must fail

expectedVisualScoreImpactNotAwarded.Material/PBR physical plausibility: medium risk reduction: rejects baked/directional or colored macro content before evidence
expectedVisualScoreImpactNotAwarded.Texture/microdetail/texel fidelity: medium risk reduction: binds anti-repeat source to reviewed deterministic content
expectedVisualScoreImpactNotAwarded.Cinematic image quality/composition/colo: small-to-medium risk reduction: prevents macro layer from becoming hidden exposure/highlight manipulation
